profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Twitter
profile.summary:
A soul needs hardness to brightly shine. 
Wisdom needs the practice to become mine.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Cerebro
Added new features to pipelines of user activity data in terabytes scale with content enrichment for user profile generation. The pipelines gathered user activity signals on contents across different Oath properties such as Yahoo Newsroom, Finance, Sports, AOL.com, TechCrunch etc for mobile and web experiences. Data is used for ad targeting and personalization. Ramped up parallel pipelines dealing with GDPR DSR daily erasure for users opting out. Coded in Java, Pig/Oozie, Perl, HiveSql. Data is kept on Hive.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Magellan
Lead the implementation of a BI analytic platform reaching >1k internal users for hundreds of TeraBytes of data generated by BrightRoll programmatic ad business. Used Looker as the visualization on top Redshift as the OLAP datastore engine. Coded Pig/Oozie for generating feeds. Puppetized a scheduler with open source Airflow for data ingestion from Yahoo! Hadoop into 2 AWS Redshift clusters. Designed and built config driven Airflow DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) factory builder to allow the evolvability of introducing more feeds with click button CICD enabled. Covered several AWS products like EC2, S3, VPC (Virtual Private Cloud), Redshift, RDS, SNS (Simple Notification Service) etc.

◆ Pipeline 24/7 Oncall (every 5 weeks)
Oncall for a pipeline with scalability and high availability of 3 geo-distributed data centers with 60B events, 15TB+ data per day, skills used: Flume, Cloudera, Hadoop, HBase, HDFS, MapReduce, Puppet, Icinga, PagerDuty, Pig, Oozie, Redshift, AWS EMR, S3, Airflow, 4 sharded MySQL clusters with master-slave replication.

◆ MapReduce on Scala for Segment Avails
Engineered a Scala MapReduce job for calculating segment avails in the Hadoop pipeline. The work ended up replacing an existing equivalent AWS EMR job and saved $4M yearly.

◆ Druid analytics
Worked on a scalable API of data platform on Druid cluster as datastore for internal usage. Contributed to the batch ingestion application for feeding Hadoop output data into Druid cluster. The platform is used to support interactive analytical queries against billions of events. Used technologies such as Scala, Java, Akka, Play Framework, etc.

◆ Prototyped the first full MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular.js, Node.js) application for a business intelligence web app of the team

projects.title: ◇ Healthcheck ◇ -- A Responsive Full-Stack Web App -- Javascript, Python, HTML, CSS
projects.description:
◆------ HealthCheck ------◆
➣ established the first responsive web app in the team that is built on MEAN stack; coded the backend using Node.js, Express and MongoDB to provided a RESTful API. Designed and build the front-end using D3, Angular.js, Zurb Foundation and customized CSS and javascript files.
➣ succeeded in providing interactive responsive data visualization of business intelligence data (pulled by Python Data Puller) using D3 combined with Angular.js (created custom directives for render the visualization charts)

◆------ Python Data Puller ------◆
➣ rebuild a data pull python script for pulling web analytics data from Adobe Omniture API and store them into MongoDB 
➣ used parallelism to speed up the data pulling procedure x10 times faster. On average only used 2 seconds per request (the old version was about 20s/request)
➣ fault-tolerance, could intelligently tolerate connection exceptions and pick up failed requests to ensure a correct result

projects.title: ◇ EduScore ◇ -- A Data Visualization Website -- Javascript, D3, Bootstrap
projects.description:
◆ Architected and designed the website of view Education Data for the non-profitable organization One World Children's Funds. Used Twitter Bootstrap as the CSS frame work.
◆ Implemented interactive geo-maps, line graphs, pie charts, combination charts etc individually for 3 continents: Africa, Asian and Amerca, using D3 and Google charts.
